To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the system identification method proposed is suitable for developing a simulation model of the DC motor system with variable inertia and a black box current regulator.
the method presented in this paper can be used to develop a model of a system with variable parameters, by using a few SISO identifications of the same system, with constant values of the parameter.

the method proposed in this thesis can be successfully used to identify a system composed by an inertia with variable value, and a current regulator, using only experimental data for a few values for the inertia.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following issues: * the development of an algorithm for the identification of a system composed by an unknown DC motor with variable inertia and an unknown current regulator; * the development of a simulation model of the system, based on the experimental data and the algorithm; * the validation of the simulation model.
the development of a simulation model of a DC motor with variable inertia and current regulator.
the development of a method to model a system composed by an inertia with a known variation range and a black box.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper presents a method for the identification of a system with time-varying parameters, using experimental data acquired with constant values of the parameters.
the proposed method is very efficient in terms of the amount of data used and in terms of the accuracy obtained in the identification process.
the method proposed in this thesis is a very useful tool for modeling a system composed of a DC motor with variable inertia.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed method can be used to develop a single model of a system with a variable inertia, using experimental data acquired with a few constant values of inertia.
a system identification procedure has been developed and successfully applied for the case of a DC motor with variable inertia.
a system identification method has been developed, based on experimental data, that can be used to model a system with a variable inertia.
The main takeaway from our work is that
this method can be applied to any kind of system, as long as the inertia can be varied.

the proposed method is able to identify the system with a good accuracy, and the obtained simulation model is able to predict the system behavior for any inertia value, including the ones that were not used for identification.
, by using a few SISO experiments, a system can be identified with a high accuracy.
